author: iWst
content: Plan agent completed gap analysis. 24 gaps identified (10 blocking, 14 advisory), 11 conflicts between original design.md and expanded spec, 71 estimated subtasks. Report at .design/realistic-planet-generator.plan.json. Critical M0-relevant findings: (B1/B2) no scaffolding exists — full WebGPU infra to build from scratch; (B5) COOP/COEP headers required for SharedArrayBuffer in Vite config; (B7) mesh-type abstraction must be designed in M0 not retrofitted at M7 — kernels need to run unchanged on global icosahedron AND level-10 clipped subset; (B4) request maxStorageBufferBindingSize near 2 GiB to fit level 10. (C3) flow accumulation will need to be GPU not CPU — pre-M3 decision, but worth flagging architecturally now. Launching M0 implementation agent next.
